answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on NumerSense and QASC to study the quality of generated knowledge and the interpretability of its impact on task performance. ... We report the quality of knowledge statements along four axes: (1) Grammaticality ... (2) Relevance ... (3) Factuality ... (4) Helpfulness ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated knowledge statement on the four criteria: grammaticality, relevance to the question, factual correctness, and helpfulness for answering the question.
